Uncertainty: Economic Policy Uncertainty index 220 (30-day mean 286, 80th percentile of the last 10 years); Geopolitical Risk index 165 (30-day mean 153, 87th percentile of the last 10 years). Regime: elevated. Policy text: Latest FOMC statement (2026-09-16) hawkish-minus-dovish score +0.42 on a -1..+1 scale, change vs previous statement +0.03.
Rate-shock signal: Hawkish (Tightening) rate shock: 10Y yield is +29 bps from its 3-month average (4.67%).

Expected returns must be TOTAL returns over the next 12 months, in percent (e.g. 7.5 or -2.0). Judge them against the cash yield given above: a return below cash is a bearish view on that asset.
Confidence describes how much the evidence above justifies deviating from those references, not how strongly the argument is worded.

Format EXACTLY like this (no markdown):
Economist: [2 concise sentences arguing a specific view]
Risk_Manager: [2 concise sentences pushing back on the Economist]
CIO_Decision: [2 sentence final synthesis]
Grounding_Summary: [1 sentence naming the specific data points that drove this decision]
SPY_Expected_Return_Percent: [number]
TLT_Expected_Return_Percent: [number]
CIO_Confidence: [High, Medium, or Low]
